Stephanie / Karthik — quick summary from the audit:

Findings:
- Invoice lines 2026-12 INV-11287 and INV-11288 include duplicated token charging for the /embed-batch route between 2026-11-22 and 2026-12-05 due to a SKU aliasing bug introduced in separate deploy (service tag: embed-v2 -> embed-batch). The underlying compute was billed twice for ~63K tokens total.
- No evidence of VAT misapplication on Redwood's side; XWave's VAT ID appears on file. VAT treatment will follow the credit memo (we need the signed clearance doc).

Recommended remediation:
1) Issue a goodwill invoice adjustment for the duplicated amount: USD 3,980.00 (this will appear as credit memo CM-4592).
2) Re-issue corrected invoices for Dec with line-level reconciliations attached.
3) Provide XWave with a short signed mutual action plan (attached: proposed_settlement_terms.docx) that documents the remediation, timing, and VAT handling.
4) Hold the renewal decision until XWave confirms acceptance; propose a one-time courtesy waiver of next month's overage fees if they sign the MAP within 7 days.

Attachments: proposed_settlement_terms.docx (Docx, 24 KB)

Marissa — please confirm finance can generate CM-4592 and route to XWave invoices inbox once Stephanie signs off. Karthik — please confirm the SKU alias patch is deployed and that future invoices will be unaffected.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
